messages:
Marta (CS): Heads up — KestrelAI renewal moved to 'watch'. We saw ~65% drop in embedding calls over the last 10 days after their infra change + new PM onboarded. Also heard they're evaluating AtlasAI POC. @Ajay (CSM) can you confirm billing sync? :eyes:
Ajay (CSM): Thanks — pulling usage now. Do we have a top-level change log? Any errors? @Ryan (SE) can you check model/latency side?
AnalyticsBot: quick snapshot: embeddings.requests_24h dropped 65% vs prior 10d. Top callers: search-service (42%), batch-sync (21%). Spike in HTTP 502s 2026-03-16 03:12 UTC. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/kestrelai/usage
Ryan (SE): saw this in infra logs — after their infra team rolled out a new SHA of our SDK they started getting backpressure. Relevant excerpt from logs:
```
2026-03-16T03:12:07Z service=search-service embed_req_id=8a2f status=502 downstream_err="kv-cache-timeout"
2026-03-16T03:12:09Z service=search-service embed_req_id=8a30 latency_ms=980 model_variant=embed-medium-quant
```
Looks like their retry logic + larger batch size caused timeouts. No model quality regression on our side.
Claire (AM): I ran a quick health call with the new PM yesterday — they mentioned cost pressure and evaluating Atlas because of a sweet pricing term. They're nervous about tail latency for interactive search.
Marta (CS): Suggested next steps: 1) Ajay schedule a 30m call with the PM + infra lead this week; 2) Offer a short dedicated trial of our low-latency embed variant (dedicated small GPU pool) for 2 weeks; 3) run a quick eval comparing tail p50/p95 across variants and share a one-pager for procurement. Thoughts?
Ajay (CSM): I'll schedule. Can we prepare a 1-page TCO note + p95 numbers? Need something procurement can forward to CFO.
Ryan (SE): I can produce p50/p95 for embed-small and embed-low-latency quant. Also propose a two-item tech ask for them: reduce batch size to 8 and switch to our async retry shim. Quick runbook:
- set ENV REDWOOD_EMBED_BATCH=8
- enable async shim: `REDWOOD_ASYNC_RETRY=true`
Marta (CS): I'll draft outreach language. Offer: 2-week trial on dedicated pool + one free enablement session with our infra SEs. If they sign trial, propose a canary migration plan and rollback criteria.
Claire (AM): I'll loop procurement and attach prior success note from AcmeHealth trial (they saw 40% latency drop).
Ajay (CSM): Meeting scheduled: Thu 2026-03-19 15:00 PT — invited PM + infra lead + procurement. Added prep doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/kestrelai-renewal-prep
Marta (CS): Great. Also flagging potential risk tier: if they go deeper with Atlas before trial starts, we escalate to Sales AE to open pricing dialogue. :warning:
Ryan (SE): I'll run a synthetic p95 test and upload results by EOD tomorrow.
AnalyticsBot: Uploaded report: https://redwood.internal/reports/kestrelai/embeds_p95_20260317.csv
Marta (CS): Thanks team. I'll post a short war-room brief after the meeting. :memo:
